Subject: Draft Recruitment Rules for the post of Stenographer in EPFO -reg
Madam/Sir,

As per the guidelines issued vide DoP&T O.M. No. AB-14017/61/2008-Estt.
(RR) dated 13.10.2015, the Draft Recruitment Rules for the post of the Stenographer in EPFO
are hereby placed on the Official Website of EPFO for inviting comments from the
stakeholders.

Any suggestions/comments/ views on the various clauses of the same along with supporting
DoP&T guidelines and rule position etc may be intimated within 30 days. The same may be
sent only to the mail id rc2.hrd@epfindia.gov.in. Comments forwarded on this issue to any

other mail id shall not be taken into consideration.

(This issues with the approval of Competent Authority)

Yours faithfully,

Enclosures: as above.
